description: React component for managing master data entities such as customers, vendors, bank accounts, and tax rates. Implements data fetching, display, and creation forms within a sidebar layout.

methods.name: MastersEntityPage
methods.description: Main React component for displaying and managing master data entities based on URL parameter. Handles data loading, validation, and creation of records.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of master records from the API for the current entity.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates form input based on entity type, specifically for required fields and rate constraints.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles form submission to create a new master record via API call, then reloads the data.
